title: Elasticsearch: In specific scenarios involving multiple clients with different DNS resolver configurations, Reactor…
description: A security vulnerability in Elasticsearch affects versions prior to 9.2.8-r13. In specific scenarios where multiple clients have different DNS resolver configurations, Reactor Netty may incorrectly reuse a previously configured DNS resolver. This can lead to limited impact on integrity without affecting confidentiality or availability. The issue has been fixed in version 9.2.8-r13.
